notes: This is a single cross section dated 2026-09-04. Nothing here observes what happened next, so none of it is evidence that the score predicts returns. It is evidence about what the score is made of.
3 component pair(s) correlate above 0.75. The worst is revisions_90d and revisions_30d at +0.77, which together carry 19% of the weight on what is largely one idea.
revisions_90d drives 21% of realised score variance on a nominal weight of 11%. It spreads names out more than its weight implies.
Rank agreement with the existing quality screen is +0.45. The two disagree substantially. At least one of them is wrong about something.

quality_value.label: return on invested capital
quality_value.why: Operating profitability is the best-replicated quality characteristic. Sector-neutral because the level is an industry property.

quality_value.label: ROIC direction
quality_value.why: A rising return on capital is weak evidence the moat is widening rather than eroding.

quality_value.label: free cash flow margin
quality_value.why: Cash conversion, discounted when it was negative in more than one of the four years.

quality_value.label: revenue CAGR
quality_value.why: Three-year revenue CAGR. Weak on its own, useful as a filter against melting ice cubes.

quality_value.label: gross margin stability
quality_value.why: Inverted standard deviation of gross margin. Weak evidence of pricing power. The softest component here.

quality_value.label: balance sheet
quality_value.why: Net debt to EBITDA, net cash pinned to the good end. Risk control rather than alpha: it predicts drawdown size, not return.

quality_value.label: forward P/E vs own median
quality_value.why: Cheap against its own four-year median, which sidesteps the sector composition problem in a raw P/E screen.

quality_value.label: EV/EBITDA vs own median
quality_value.why: The same comparison on an enterprise basis, so leverage and cash do not distort it.

quality_value.label: next-year EPS revision, 90 days
quality_value.why: Estimate revision momentum is among the more replicated effects and works at the horizon this portfolio rebalances on.

quality_value.label: next-year EPS revision, 30 days
quality_value.why: The same signal, fresher and noisier.

quality_value.label: analyst agreement
quality_value.why: Up minus down over total revising. Asks whether the analysts who moved agreed, rather than how many cover the name.

quality_value.label: share count change
quality_value.why: Net share issuance is one of the more robust characteristics, and it is cheap and clean to measure.

quality_value.label: short interest
quality_value.why: Heavily shorted names underperform on average. Small weight: at this liquidity it is mostly noise.
